name: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic
label: Item
description: Stormwind's mages once guarded Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic, but Morganth stole the perilous tome and hid it in the Tower of Ilgalar.
intro: Stormwind's mages once guarded Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic, but Morganth stole the perilous tome and hid it in the Tower of Ilgalar.

p: Ur of Dalaran wrote a treatise on shadow magic and its subtle, corruptive nature. The mages of the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind feared that such arts could bring doom and ruin to the unwary, so they sealed the volume against readers. After Morganth surrendered to dark arts and Stormwind's magical circle exiled him, he took the tome east into the Redridge Mountains, to his stronghold at the Tower of Ilgalar.
